description: Send a LinkedIn connection request with a note to a prospect from the connected LinkedIn account. This reaches a real person immediately and cannot be undone. Pass the note you want sent, or omit it to use the saved draft. Requires LinkedIn connected in getcleed under Integrations.

message.description: The note, max 300 characters. Omit to use the saved draft
